apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gke-processor
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: gke-processor
    tier: stream
    workload: castor-fleet
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gke-processor
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gke-processor
        tier: stream
        workload: castor-fleet
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: processor
          image: gcr.io/castor-fleet/gke-processor:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              name: http
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          env:
            - name: PROJECT_ID
              value: ""
            - name: PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
              value: "fleet-stream-sub"
            - name: FIRESTORE_COLLECTION
              value: "fleet_analytics"
            - name: BATCH_SIZE
              value: "50"
            - name: FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECONDS
              value: "5.0"
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 2
